newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rain set to return to France on Saturday.
newsitem.headline: Rain set to return to France on Saturday.

text.p: Dry weather and above normal temperatures were forecast across France on Friday but scattered showers and cooler conditions were set to return on Saturday, cheering farmers after a long dry spell, forecasters said.
More substantial rain was in store for Sunday afternoon and Monday, they said.
"The forecast is cloudless skies and summer temperatures for Friday but there will clouds and showers in western France tomorrow," a Meteo France forecaster said.
"Saturday's showers will herald a change in the weather pattern, which could bring in more substantial rain early next week," he said.
Temperatures will reach 23 degrees in the north and 25-28 degrees in the south on Friday but are set to return to normal for spring on Saturday.
A three-month dry spell has raised fears of crop damage and pushed up domestic grain prices.
A brief bout of rain last week brought thirsty crops some relief but did little to solve the long-term problem caused by the prolonged drought.
